question: Who was the first winner of the Arjuna Award in Kabaddi?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sahanand Mahadev Shetty**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Arjuna Award,** introduced in **1961,** recognized outstanding achievements in various sports disciplines.
 
• Sahanand Shetty, a versatile kabaddi player from Maharashtra, was the inaugural recipient, having secured 12 Senior National Championship titles with Indian Railways.
 
• Following suit, Shakuntala Khatavkar became the first female awardee in kabaddi in 1978.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] 

**Important Points__**

__
 
• Officially titled the **Arjuna Awards** for Outstanding Performance in Sports and Games, this prestigious honor is conferred annually by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports.
 
• Prior to the establishment of the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna in 1991–1992, the Arjuna Award held the distinction of being India's highest sporting accolade.
 
• As of 2020, the award package includes a bronze statuette of Arjuna, a certificate, ceremonial attire, and a cash prize of ₹15 lakh.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Manjeet Chhillar, **a former Indian kabaddi player, now assumes the role of assistant coach for the Telugu Titans. Known for his exceptional skills on the kabaddi mat, Chhillar has transitioned into coaching, contributing his expertise to the development of the sport.
 
• **BC Ramesh** is a prominent figure in Indian kabaddi, distinguished both as a player and a coach. Honored with the Arjuna Award in 2001, he boasts an illustrious career that includes clinching two gold medals while representing India on the kabaddi field. 
 
• **Bholanath Guin **was a recipient of the Arjuna Award in 1973. This prestigious award is bestowed upon outstanding athletes in recognition of their exceptional performance and contribution to sports in India.
